rules.name: ouat178-mysql-vs-uat
rules.sql: SELECT security_id, derivative_type, underlying1_id, underlying2_id, vol1_id, vol2_id, strike, maturity_date, settlement_type, currency, contract_month FROM dbsystemuat.security_info_table_cfs WHERE security_id LIKE 'CM WP%'

SELECT security_id, derivative_type, underlying1_id, underlying2_id, vol1_id, vol2_id, strike, maturity_date, settlement_type, currency, contract_month FROM opera.security_info_table WHERE business_unit = 'CFS' AND security_id LIKE 'CM WP%' AND status = 'Active'
SELECT vol_id, bbg_opt_ticker, expiry_date FROM dbsystemuat.vol_id_table WHERE vol_id LIKE 'CM QW%' OR vol_id LIKE 'CM SB%'
SELECT vol_id, bbg_opt_ticker, expiry_date FROM opera.vol_id_table WHERE vol_id LIKE 'CM QW%' OR vol_id LIKE 'CM SB%'
SELECT bbg_underlying_id, settlement_date, price, vol FROM dbsystemuat.var_price_vol_table WHERE settlement_date = :sd AND (bbg_underlying_id LIKE 'QW%' OR bbg_underlying_id LIKE 'SB%')
SELECT bbg_underlying_id, settlement_date, price, vol FROM opera.var_price_vol_table WHERE settlement_date = :sd AND (bbg_underlying_id LIKE 'QW%' OR bbg_underlying_id LIKE 'SB%')
SELECT dat_code, MAX(zero_rate) AS zero_rate FROM dbsystemuat.cso_zero_rate_curve_table WHERE settle_date = :sd AND currency = 'USD' GROUP BY dat_code
SELECT dat_code, MAX(zero_rate) AS zero_rate FROM opera.cso_zero_rate_curve_table WHERE business_unit = 'CFS' AND settle_date = :sd AND currency = 'USD' GROUP BY dat_code

SELECT TRIM(product_code) AS product_code, TRIM(primary_code) AS primary_code, TRIM(secondary_code) AS secondary_code, primary_multiplier, secondary_multiplier FROM dbsystemuat.correl_product_mapping_cfs

SELECT TRIM(product_code) AS product_code, TRIM(primary_code) AS primary_code, TRIM(secondary_code) AS secondary_code, primary_multiplier, secondary_multiplier FROM opera.correl_product_mapping WHERE business_unit = 'CFS'

SELECT CASE WHEN underlying_id LIKE '%QW%' THEN 'QW' WHEN underlying_id LIKE '%SB%' THEN 'SB' ELSE 'other' END AS leg, COUNT(*) AS row_count, COUNT(ratio_return) AS ratio_not_null, ROUND(SUM(ratio_return), 8) AS ratio_sum FROM dbsystemuat.settlement_price_table_wp_cfs GROUP BY 1

SELECT CASE WHEN underlying_id LIKE '%QW%' THEN 'QW' WHEN underlying_id LIKE '%SB%' THEN 'SB' ELSE 'other' END AS leg, count(*) AS row_count, count(ratio_return) AS ratio_not_null, round(sum(ratio_return)::numeric, 8) AS ratio_sum FROM opera.settlement_price_table_wp WHERE business_unit = 'CFS' GROUP BY 1
SELECT * FROM dbsystemuat.scicom_cso_correl_table WHERE security_id LIKE 'CM WP%' ORDER BY settlement_date DESC LIMIT 12
SELECT group_type, security_id, product_code, settlement_date, correl_12 FROM opera.recon_scicom_correlation_input WHERE business_unit = 'CFS' ORDER BY settlement_date DESC, security_id LIMIT 12

SELECT value_date, security_id, settle_price, settle_delta_1, settle_delta_2, settle_vega_1, settle_theta FROM dbsystemuat.security_settlement_value_table_cfs WHERE security_id LIKE 'CM WP%' ORDER BY value_date DESC, security_id LIMIT 12

SELECT value_date, security_id, settle_price, settle_delta_1, settle_delta_2, settle_vega_1, settle_theta FROM opera.security_settlement_value_table WHERE business_unit = 'CFS' AND security_id LIKE 'CM WP%' ORDER BY value_date DESC, security_id LIMIT 12

expect.reason: QW and SB prices and vols equal
